reviews.comment:
Debe ser la mejor de Santiago, no le pongo 5 porque creo que sería injusto para aquellas estaciones de servicio mas grandes, con mas estacionamiento, comedor y esas cosas...pero para el centro de Santiago, es completa y bien atendida, las veces que fuí no tuvo inconveniente alguno, el bar es tipico ypf, no te deja en banda. Recomendado además por su combustible confiable, eso vale muuuucho últimamente

(Translated by Google)
It has to be the best in Santiago. I'm not giving it 5 stars because I think that would be unfair to the larger stations with more parking, a restaurant, and all that... but for downtown Santiago, it's complete and well-run. Every time I've been, I've had no problems. The bar is typical YPF; they don't let you down. Also recommended for their reliable fuel, which is worth a lot these days.
